why: The paper 'Tunnel number one knots satisfy the Berge Conjecture' (Li et al., arXiv:1701.01421) was revised through Nov 2024 and formally published in Geometry & Topology in 2025, proving the conjecture for the restricted case of tunnel number one knots in S^3 -- a case of the stated problem, not a different one.
